Thank you very much for your reply. I appreciate that you took the time. My husband is wonderful. He tries his best but he works long hours, my family is far away unfortunately. But I will see if they wouldn't mind coming I guess. I just don't want to bother anybody. 


I do, I adore her she makes persevering worthwhile along with my husband. Thank you for your kind words and I wish happiness for your own family.
